free_tier.stated: No free allowance. Priced plans per month, excl. VAT: BX11 1 TB at € 3.20, BX21 5 TB at € 10.90, BX31 10 TB at € 20.80, BX41 20 TB at € 40.60. Traffic is unlimited on every plan.

egress.terms: Unlimited traffic on every plan ('Each Storage Box comes with unlimited traffic'); capacity is the only billed axis. Concurrent connections are limited to 10.

chaining: No free allowance; priced benchmark: a 20 TB archive costs € 40.60 per month excl. VAT on BX41, 10 TB costs € 20.80 on BX31.

limits.value: 1, 5, 10 or 20 TB per Storage Box (BX11 to BX41)

limits_note: 10 concurrent connections is the binding limit, not bytes — a parallel-GET benchmark will be shaped by connection count: 32 parallel ranged GETs cannot be opened here, only 10. 10 snapshots. No per-file cap published.

identity_cost.detail: payment methods: bank transfer, credit card, Paypal and SEPA direct debit (SEPA-country accounts); the registration fields are unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: RAID with checksums, explicitly NOT mirrored off-site ('The data is not mirrored onto other servers'). Snapshots can be automated. Long-standing German host; no data-loss pattern in these forums.
